timing: after the first full B1 run, found while building the register (the loader validator rejected ref_FUN). Disclosed post-hoc; strictly fail-closed (can only exclude).
finding: In 7 baseline ids the security master holds two rows with the SAME canonical_id (ref_BAM, ref_CCSI, ref_FUN, ref_HUT, ref_NYXH, ref_TEL, ref_UHAL_B; e.g. ref_FUN: tiingo:NYSE:FUN:1987-04-23 once ACTIVE to 2026-09-10 and once INACTIVE to 2024-07-16). A SELECT_EXISTING_ROW binding identifies its row by canonical_id, so for these ids the selection is not unique.

changes.after: new exclusion reason SELECTED_ROW_NOT_UNIQUE when the selected canonical_id occurs in more than one master row of the baseline id; the loader additionally fails closed (IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_MASTER_ROWS_CHANGED) if the selected canonical_id is not unique among the rows, and the register validator rejects such a record.
